karty.priklad: Gofynnon ni am arian gan Fenter Cymru i addasu adeiladau.
karty.priklad_cs: We asked Menter Cymru for money to adapt buildings (Menter → [F]enter after gan).
karty.mnemo: addas = suitable: addasu = to make something suitable.

sever.priklad: Gofynnon ni am bres gan Fenter Cymru i addasu adeiladau.
sever.priklad_cs: We asked Menter Cymru for money to adapt buildings (pres → [b]res after am).

karty.priklad: Does dim egni yn eich gêm chi. Wnaethoch chi ddim cicio'r bêl!
karty.priklad_cs: There's no energy in your game. You didn't even kick the ball! (pêl → [b]êl after the article y, feminine)

extra.pozn: sentence switched to the polite chi form throughout; check against the coursebook pp. 76–85

karty.priklad: Mae'r cawr yn codi ofn ar blant y pentre.
karty.priklad_cs: The giant frightens the children of the village (plant → [b]lant after ar).

extra.pozn: the mutation comes from ar: codi ofn ar blant; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r merched yn gobeithio byddan nhw'n cyflogi person arall yn y dyfodol.
karty.priklad_cs: The women hope they'll employ another person in the future.
karty.mnemo: cyflog (wage): cyflogi = to pay someone a wage, to employ.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n cyfrannu at bapur bro'r ardal bob mis.
karty.priklad_cs: I contribute to the local community paper every month (papur → [b]apur after at).
karty.mnemo: cy- + rhan (part, share): to put in your share.

extra.pozn: the mutation comes from at; papur bro = a Welsh local community monthly; own example

karty.cs: to put, to place; to set, to lay (a table)
karty.priklad: Gosodais i'r bwrdd cyn i'r gwesteion gyrraedd.
karty.priklad_cs: I laid the table before the guests arrived (cyrraedd → [g]yrraedd after the subject in the cyn i… construction).
karty.mnemo: dannedd gosod = teeth that are set in (dentures); llyfr gosod = a set book.

karty.priklad: Dw i ddim yn gallu gwadu hynny. Ond dw i ar frys.
karty.priklad_cs: I can't deny that. But I'm in a hurry.
karty.mnemo: The GUARD (GWAD-u) denies everything: "Nobody got past me!"

sever.priklad: Dw i ddim yn medru gwadu hynny. Ond dw i ar frys.
sever.priklad_cs: I can't deny that. But I'm in a hurry.

karty.priklad: Wnest ti'r cwrs nyrsio? Naddo, wnes i mo'r cwrs nyrsio.
karty.priklad_cs: Did you do the nursing course? No, I didn't do the nursing course (gwneud → [w]nes; ddim o'r → mo'r).

karty.priklad: I bwy mae'r llyfr yma'n perthyn?
karty.priklad_cs: Who does this book belong to? (pwy → [b]wy after i)
karty.mnemo: perthynas (relative): your relatives belong to you.

extra.pozn: perthyn i = to belong to someone; own example

karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n gwadu bydd dŵr brwnt yn broblem iechyd.
karty.priklad_cs: They deny that dirty water will be a health problem (problem → [b]roblem after yn).
karty.mnemo: A muddy puddle: you take the BRUNT (BRWNT) of the dirty splash.

sever.priklad: Maen nhw'n gwadu bydd dŵr budr yn broblem iechyd.
sever.priklad_cs: They deny that dirty water will be a health problem.
sever.pozn: north: budr instead of brwnt (Geirfa L7)

karty.priklad: Mae'r llety cathod a chŵn wedi bod yn llwyddiannus iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The cat and dog boarding kennels have been very successful (cŵn → [ch]ŵn after a).

extra.pozn: own example based on the article on p. 86

karty.priklad: Pob lwc i Del, Jan, Helen a Lynette – pedair merch fentrus a llwyddiannus!
karty.priklad_cs: Good luck to Del, Jan, Helen and Lynette – four enterprising and successful women! (mentrus → [f]entrus after the feminine merch)

extra.pozn: after a (and) only c, p, t change (aspirate mutation), so llwyddiannus stays unmutated: a llwyddiannus

karty.priklad: Beth am ysgrifennu un gerdd ramantus?
karty.priklad_cs: How about writing a romantic poem? (cerdd → [g]erdd after un, feminine; rhamantus → [r]amantus after the feminine cerdd)

sever.priklad: Be am sgwennu un gerdd ramantus?
sever.priklad_cs: How about writing a romantic poem?
sever.pozn: north: Be instead of Beth (L9), sgwennu instead of ysgrifennu (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dw i ar frys. Mae cyfarfod pwysig gyda fi, a dw i'n hwyr.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm in a hurry. I've got an important meeting and I'm late (brys → [f]rys after ar).

sever.priklad: Dw i ar frys. Mae gen i gyfarfod pwysig, a dw i'n hwyr.
sever.priklad_cs: I'm in a hurry. I've got an important meeting and I'm late.
sever.pozn: north: Mae gen i instead of Mae … gyda fi (L6), soft mutation after gen: cyfarfod → [g]yfarfod

karty.cs: to come to an end, to finish
karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n gwadu bydd y grŵp yn dod i ben.
karty.priklad_cs: They deny the group will come to an end (pen → [b]en after i).
karty.mnemo: pen = head, end: coming to the end.

karty.priklad: Gadawais i'r parsel wrth y drws ffrynt.
karty.priklad_cs: I left the parcel by the front door.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the arall box; as a noun it is masculine (like drws), pl. drysau ffrynt (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Dewch i'r cyfarfod i ddweud eich dweud!
karty.priklad_cs: Come to the meeting to have your say! (dweud → [dd]weud after i)

extra.pozn: the possessive changes: dweud fy nweud, dweud ei ddweud, dweud ei dweud; own example

sever.priklad: Dewch i'r cyfarfod i ddeud eich deud!
sever.priklad_cs: Come to the meeting to have your say! (deud → [dd]eud after i)
sever.pozn: north: deud instead of dweud (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hwyr, sori! – Gwell hwyr na hwyrach!
karty.priklad_cs: I'm late, sorry! – Better late than never!

extra.pozn: in the coursebook (p. 83) the police officer says it ironically: better to arrive late than not at all

karty.priklad: Mewn gwirionedd, do'n i ddim yn hoffi'r ffilm.
karty.priklad_cs: Actually, I didn't like the film.

karty.cs: if it weren't for, but for
karty.priklad: Oni bai amdanat ti, faswn i ddim wedi llwyddo.
karty.priklad_cs: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have succeeded.
karty.mnemo: oni bai = were it not: if it weren't for (am) you.

extra.tvary: amdana i, amdanat ti, amdano fe, amdani hi, amdanon ni, amdanoch chi, amdanyn nhw

karty.priklad: Mae dros ddeg y cant o'r bobl yn ddi-waith.
karty.priklad_cs: Over ten per cent of the people are unemployed (deg → [dd]eg after dros; pobl → [b]obl after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: cant = hundred: "of the hundred" – exactly like per cent.

extra.pozn: the number comes first: deg y cant = 10%

karty.priklad: Wedyn aeth fy nghar i yn erbyn wal.
karty.priklad_cs: Then my car went into a wall (car → [ngh]ar after fy).
karty.mnemo: ERB-yn ~ HER BIN: I bumped against her bin.

extra.tvary: yn fy erbyn i, yn dy erbyn di, yn ei erbyn e, yn ei herbyn hi, yn ein herbyn ni, yn eich erbyn chi, yn eu herbyn nhw

karty.priklad: Roedd Robin mewn gwisg ffansi yn y llun.
karty.priklad_cs: Robin was in fancy dress in the photo.

karty.priklad: Welaist ti'r llun ohono i? Mae e'n llun da iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: Did you see the photo of me? It's a very good picture (gweld → [w]elaist).

sever.priklad: Welaist ti'r llun ohono i? Mae o'n llun da iawn.
sever.priklad_cs: Did you see the photo of me? It's a very good picture.

karty.priklad: Gofynnon nhw i fi wisgo fel cwningen, ond gwrthodais i.
karty.priklad_cs: They asked me to dress up as a rabbit, but I refused (gwisgo → [w]isgo after i fi).

extra.pozn: past tense of gwrthod (to refuse); Robin Radio, p. 87; own sentence

sever.priklad: Gofynnon nhw i mi wisgo fel cwningen, ond gwrthodais i.
sever.priklad_cs: They asked me to dress up as a rabbit, but I refused (gwisgo → [w]isgo after i mi).
sever.pozn: north: i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)
